##### Project general facts

Creek Vista Heights is a towering contemporary residence reaching new heights in Sobha Hartland. This pre-eminent address offers the height of contemporary living in sixty-four stories of world-class craftsmanship, with bespoke residences featuring full-height windows to maximize all-encompassing views. Offering one to three-and-a-half-bedroom bespoke luxury apartments, Creek Vista Heights presents a unique charm that is truly unparalleled, where residents can live on cloud nine.

Residents enjoy an exceptional array of amenities designed to elevate every aspect of daily life. Take a plunge in a state-of-the-art swimming pool or work on those tan lines by the poolside. A fully equipped gym promises exceptional facilities designed to relieve the stresses of the day, every day. Specially carved out areas for little ones allow children to play to their hearts' content, while ideal spaces to socialize connect residents with people as discerning as they are. Whether marvelling at the golden sunset glistening on Dubai Canal during the day, or the city lights sparkling at night, life has never looked or felt so sensual.

Every residence at Creek Vista Heights features elegant, opulent yet practical interiors with a new level of refinement. The bespoke residences are designed with premium quality finishes, offering fully equipped kitchens and thoughtfully crafted living spaces. Full-height windows maximize all-encompassing views, creating a living experience that is both sensual and sophisticated. Every detail reflects a commitment to elevating the lives of residents through thoughtfully crafted living spaces.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Sobha Hartland, this exceptional location offers proximity to vibrant Downtown Dubai with high-end finishes and a unique charm that is truly unparalleled. The community is surrounded by the city's most iconic landmarks, with Dubai Canal, Dubai Mall, and Burj Khalifa within easy reach, offering a lifestyle of convenience and sophistication.

The location is distinguished by its strategic connectivity and abundant amenities. The community features green spaces, parks, and a waterfront boardwalk, creating a serene environment while maintaining easy access to Dubai's key destinations. The area's thoughtful planning ensures residents enjoy the perfect balance of urban energy and tranquil living.

For those seeking a residence that embodies the height of contemporary living, world-class craftsmanship, and a prime Dubai address, Sobha Hartland delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of strategic connectivity, world-class amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can get high on life.
